summary: The single typed task60 command, producer, completion and lower-read owner.

rows.shim: xm1_loading_configuration, xm1_loading_startup, xm1_loading_ready, xm1_loading_legacy_request, xm1_loading_legacy_cancel, xm1_loading_configure, xm1_loading_absolute_deadline, xm1_loading_initialize, xm1_loading_request, xm1_loading_request_sync, xm1_loading_cancel, xm1_loading_wait_channel and xm1_loading_observe_completion
rows.other_side: startup construction, stock task60 wrapper callers and Develop loading callers
rows.removal: all callers use the Rust API in one final composition

evidence.requirement: Reference-only until the Root bank's loading variant is bound in replacement/shim-images.json. //replacement/saclac:saclac-image-loading-* export these bodies; stage-saclac publishes the 0x73ac74/0x73ac94/0x73aca4 veneers only when all three are linked. The composition supplies one schema1 policy; each posted request forms one finite absolute deadline and carries it unchanged through read and cleanup. A published completion latch answers as stock flashloader_request/cancel do, without posting. No duration, default or cleanup budget is fitted by the library.

rows.shim: task60 queue, task, wait, signal and current-task leaves
rows.other_side: retained RTOS message and semaphore services
rows.removal: the kernel owns typed queue and wait APIs

evidence.requirement: Reference-only until the Root bank's loading variant is bound. Queue60 keeps the stock dispatch_create_channel geometry (0x30 messages of 16 bytes); each message carries (request id, kind) and the 24-byte envelope is the owned per-command record XM1_LOADING_ENVELOPES. Task startup preserves the nine reserved completion semaphores and task-id publication.

rows.shim: NAND, decoder, segment, extent, progress and delegated-command leaves
rows.other_side: retained X-M1 services; the owned image5 decoder and NAND owner are called directly in the same bank
rows.removal: the corresponding device and delegated command units are owned

evidence.requirement: Reference-only until the Root bank's loading variant is bound. The DMA unit is 0x20000 bytes; plain backing 0x360000 and image5 staging 0x2e0000 bytes; 0x100000 is a controller budget. Producers use stock segment ids 5 (image5) and 6 (plain); the plain progress reporter is the source-inspected void ABI at 0x73b924. NAND and decoder are owned and linked in the same bank.
